searchText: I apologize if this is a stupid question, or the wrong place to ask it, but can you help me understand the pessimism implied by this market: https://polymarket.com/market/will-eip-1559-be-implemented-on-the-ethereum-mainnet-before-august-5-2021 ? All news articles I’ve read seem to say that things are going ahead as scheduled. I must be missing something obvious, I’d love to know what it is. To be clear, I’m not recommending anyone participate in this platform or this market, I’m trying to understand for myself, as I’m really excited about Ethereum, but seem like I must be ignorant to some credible news source. Seems like everyone even semi-close to the project is confident in the ~August 4th date. Maybe a bunch of people voting that haven't been following, but have heard of delays happening before, so they assume they'll happen here. Hi all I've got something truly offtopic that I hope you can help me out with I'd like to help gamestop shareholders understand core concepts of cryptocurrency this is because gamestop is working on an NFT platform over ethereum I'm not an expert by any means but I feel I have a decent understanding of it all, but explaining it to someone who doesn't really know much about crypto seems difficult are there any good learning resources that I could share with them to help them out? thanks in advance I may just share this link with them instead: https://youtu.be/O1JqruIrdmQ It's a bit more NFT art focused, but it seems solid for crypto fundamentals https://etherscan.io/block/countdown/12965000 This is why Can someone send some Ropsten ETH to 0x0C415dA839CD6395CE9Bb75bFb5613Cee4098888 ? Can't find any working faucets anywhere. https://cryptodaily.co.uk/2021/07/ethereum-roundup-july-18?_source=Discord&utm_medium=App Is it realistic for a smart contract to iterate over 1M+ addresses and distribute funds among them given gas constraints? A better question for https://discord.gg/az2SH6aX Also, please don't spam multiple channels. +1. I appreciate it
